rachel_sales: SOS — customer 'Nimbus' can't call /v1/generate, getting 403. POC demo in 90m.

Tom_eng: Can you paste the curl and response body? 403 often = project binding or scope.

rachel_sales: They used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_NIM' -d '{"model":"rwx-3b","input":"test"}'`
Response: `{"error":{"code":403,"message":"Forbidden: invalid project binding"}}`

lee_support: Ask them to decode the token claims and check `project` and `scopes`. I suspect scope missing.

rachel_sales: Claims they pasted: `{"sub":"svc:nimbus","project":"nimbus-poc","scopes":["embeddings:read"]}`

Tom_eng: Yep — only embeddings:read. Need `inference:invoke`. I'll spin a temp service key scoped to inference and bind to nimbus-poc.

maria_sec: Quick note for customer: if we rotate keys we can route through their KMS later; audit logs retained 90 days.

lee_support: Temp key sk_temp_nim created and delivered via secure link. Remind them to add header `X-Project-ID: nimbus-poc`. Ticket #POC-778.

rachel_sales: They tried new key + header but saw 401: `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="signature verification failed"`.

Tom_eng: Signature failed usually from copying with extra newline/quotes. Ask them to `echo -n "$TOKEN" | wc -c` and confirm length matches.

lee_support: They fixed env var export (removed trailing newline) and retried — 200 OK. Demo is go.

rachel_sales: Thanks team. Final Q from Nimbus: will they need Dedicated for latency?

Tom_eng: For small POCs hosted is fine. For production with tight p99 SLOs and sustained throughput, recommend Dedicated. Sent pricing notes in DM.

lee_support: Root cause: token lacked inference scope + missing X-Project-ID; secondary: token copy/trailing newline caused signature error. Documented in POC-778. :white_check_mark:
